training.population: BTS train+val splits (8,922 objects); test split (1,575 objects) untouched

crossfit.note: GAMUT dual-weighted posterior-mixture level sets calibrated on five-fold out-of-fold predictions over BTS train+val (8,709 objects; test split untouched). Crossfit mode fits leave-one-object-out residual laws, dual weights and thresholds on all OOF objects; validity of the shipped bundle is checked empirically out of fold and on the untouched test split.

split.note: GAMUT dual-weighted posterior-mixture level sets calibrated on five-fold out-of-fold predictions over BTS train+val (8,709 objects; test split untouched). Split mode fits nuisances and dual weights on half A and per-class object-level thresholds on half B; validity of the shipped bundle is checked empirically out of fold and on the untouched test split.

deployed_test_check.grid_note: Shipped models/bts6/forecast boosters were fitted on train+val+test (10,497 objects), so grid test-split residuals are in-sample; see models/bts6/forecast/h*.json for grid's out-of-fold per-class coverage and oof_lofo_check for GAMUT's 5-fold out-of-fold coverage.
